messages:
ashley_cs: Starting Coralway day0 onboarding thread. Customer needs object-level audit proof + stable egress IPs for Splunk before renewal review in 9 business days. Need owners for VPC endpoints/egress, KMS policy + rotation, CloudTrail delivery check, and a concise runbook. @omar_net @sana_sec @ben_ops?

omar_net: I can own VPC endpoints + egress. Are they ok with S3 gateway endpoints? That avoids NAT for log delivery. If Splunk must be reachable directly we'll provide static egress IPs.

sana_sec: I'll take KMS/IAM and CloudTrail validation. Plan: create CMK with rotation, narrow key policy, and a CloudTrailDelivery role. Will check bucket SSE-KMS and bucket policy.

ben_ops: I'll draft the one-pager runbook and schedule a 20m walkthrough. Proposed time: tomorrow 11:00 PT. Runbook will include validation steps and commands to produce the evidence artifact.

omar_net: quick firewall notes for runbook:
- prefer S3 gateway endpoint for audit delivery
- if internet egress needed, allow 443 to splunk.coralway.example and restrict source to ALB/NAT subnets
I'll open a small terraform PR with the endpoint by EOD.

sana_sec: KMS policy snippet (high level): {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::CORALWAY:role/CloudTrailDelivery"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"},{"Effect":"Deny","Principal":"*","Action":"kms:*","Condition":{"StringNotEquals":{"aws:PrincipalAccount":"999888777666"}}}]}
I'll post a hardened version after review.

ben_ops: Walkthrough invite sent to Coralway security and platform. I'll attach the one-pager and include steps to: list recent S3 objects, head-object to check x-amz-server-side-encryption, and confirm Splunk HEC ingestion.

ashley_cs: Renewal risk note: Finance expects the evidence uploaded to the account folder within 7 business days to avoid escalation. Let's aim for that.

omar_net: PR opened: infra/terraform-endpoints #609 by @omar_net  contains S3 gateway endpoint. Will add egress IPs if needed.

sana_sec: I'll run validations post-PR merge and post the evidence commands here. If anything fails I'll file a blocker.

ops-bot: CI: infra/terraform-endpoints PR #609 created  reviewers requested.

ashley_cs: Thanks team. After the walkthrough please drop the evidence pack here and I'll update the renewal flag.
